# Ruleset

`rulesets.cloudflare.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1` · Namespaced · [all resources](../README.md)

| Operation | Request |
|---|---|
| observe | `GET /zones/{zone_id}/rulesets/{ruleset_id}` |
| create | `POST /zones/{zone_id}/rulesets` |
| update | `PUT /zones/{zone_id}/rulesets/{ruleset_id}` |
| delete | `DELETE /zones/{zone_id}/rulesets/{ruleset_id}` |

Credentials: via zone → account.

## Example

```yaml
apiVersion: rulesets.cloudflare.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Ruleset
metadata:
  name: example
spec:
  forProvider:
    kind: "managed"
    phase: "ddos_l4"
    zoneRef:
      name: <name>
```
